description: Real provider-reported token cost savings using Groq API and comparison with synthetic tokenizer benchmarks

groq_provider_results.claim: Groq usage accounting showed 14.4% prompt-token reduction on the selected Groq-hosted model for this benchmark.

synthetic_tokenizer_comparison.test_corpus: 160 synthetic RSTF adversarial examples (reversed, upside_down, homoglyph, bidi_override)

key_findings: Groq provider accounting showed 14.4% real token savings on 6 test examples
Synthetic tiktoken benchmark showed 75.6% savings on 160 adversarial examples
OverLLM BPE tokenizer showed 66.4% savings on synthetic corpus
Upside-down transforms produce the largest savings (88.1% tiktoken)
Real provider savings (14.4%) lower than synthetic benchmarks due to different test corpus and model tokenization
Synthetic benchmarks use 160 examples, Groq test used 6 examples
Different tokenizers (Groq Llama vs tiktoken GPT-4o) produce different savings rates
production_disclaimer: Groq results are real provider usage accounting on a small test corpus. Synthetic benchmarks use 160 adversarial examples and may not represent production traffic patterns. Actual savings depend on your specific input distribution, model choice, and provider pricing.
